remarks:
Welcome to 1380 Maple Road, Unit 8, a beautifully updated condo in the desirable Oakbrook community. 
This bright and inviting home features 2 spacious bedrooms, 1 full and 1 half bath , an updated kitchen with new stainless steel appliances and a wonderful open living dining area . Both bathrooms have been beautifully updated with Kohler fixtures , high end flooring and vanities . Fresh paint throughout and a Nest smart thermostat. Enjoy the convenience of a washer and dryer included, offering in-unit laundry, plus your own private basement storage space. Oakbrook is one of Amherst's most sought-after communities known for its beautifully kept grounds, and outstanding amenities, including a pool, tennis courts, clubhouse and walking paths. Located just minutes from Transit Rd, UB, shops, restaurants, parks and everything Amherst has to offer. Top rated Williamsville schools. Maple East elementary, Transit Middle and East Fresh, modern, and ready to welcome its new owner!
